# RecruitPro AI

> Smart AI Resume Screening & Candidate Ranking Platform

RecruitPro AI is an enterprise-grade AI recruitment software designed for recruiters, hiring managers, and HR teams to automate resume screening, rank candidates using multi-model NLP, extract matched vs missing skills, and generate candidate summaries and technical interview questions.

## Product Purpose
RecruitPro AI reduces candidate screening time by up to 80% through intelligent document parsing, TF-IDF lexical frequency analysis, sentence-transformer semantic embedding similarity (MiniLM), and automated interview question generation.

## Core Features
- Job Skill Extraction: Automatic detection of required technical and soft skills from job descriptions.
- Bulk Resume Upload: Multi-file drag-and-drop processing for PDF and DOCX formats.
- Composite Candidate Scoring: Multi-model matching using exact skill overlaps, TF-IDF similarity, and semantic vector embeddings.
- AI Interview Package Generation: Auto-generated technical interview questions probing candidate skill gaps, along with concise neutral hiring recommendations.
- Shortlist Export & Notifications: Candidate shortlisting exportable as PDF/CSV and report delivery via email.
